This vignette is a tutorial for the entire pipeline of the Autoencoding Random Forests (RFAE) algorithm. This consists of:
- Training a base Random Forests (RF) model
- Using the trained RF to encode data into embeddings 
- Decoding the embeddings back into the input space. 

```{r rfae}
# Load libraries
library(RFAE)
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

set.seed(42)
```
